Section 204A.2, Code 2026, is amended by adding 13 the following new subsection: 14 NEW SUBSECTION . 9A. a. “Minimally processed hemp” means 15 all of the following: 16 (1) Hemp that is in a form attributable to harvesting, 17 drying, curing, trimming, packaging, or customary post-harvest 18 handling. 19 (2) Hemp that has not been subject to alteration by any 20 means, including but not limited to any of the following: 21 (a) A chemical conversion. 22 (b) An added nonbotanical substance. 23 b. “Minimally processed hemp” includes hemp that has been 24 subject to a process of combining or blending the hemp with 25 one or more plant-based substances, if the resulting material 26 remains in an unadulterated form. 27 c. “Minimally processed hemp” does not include a consumable 28 hemp product as regulated under chapter 204. 29 Sec. ___.
